entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling about an order I received recently. I'd like to start a return for a pair of cycling shoes.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number?

Got it. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Carbon-Sole cycling shoes, delivered 11 days ago. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue?
They just aren't working for me. I spent a good amount of time setting up the cleats, but after just one ride, I developed some serious blisters on my heels. The fit feels all wrong.

I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is the last thing you want when you're trying to enjoy a ride. Let me check the return eligibility for you. Okay, good news. You are well within the 90-day return period.
So, I can get a full refund then?
Yes, absolutely. I can process a full refund for you. I am sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file right now. You should see it in the next few minutes.

That's great, I appreciate that. Now, since I'll be ordering a different model from you, and I did go through this hassle, is there any chance you could provide a 10% discount code for my next purchase?

I understand the request, and I'm glad we could get this return approved for you so easily. While my system doesn't allow me to issue a discount code with a return, I can assure you the full refund will be processed as soon as the item is scanned at the post office.
Okay, that's fair. I had to ask. Thanks for your help.
Of course. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thank you.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can find you a pair of shoes that work better for you. Have a great day.
